cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
cards.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I made it through the speech without leaving. Was that enough?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I know. I'm asking about staying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You stayed all the way through. I'll help you practise the missing bit tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could staying earn me tomorrow off? Tell me I can put the speech away.

mechanism: A instructs B in competent evaluation in order to hear that A's limited effort was enough.
confusable: Seeking praise for excellence differs from directing the evaluator toward sufficiency and permission to stop.
comparison: A joint exhibition needs validation of one contribution; a difficult speech needs completion recognized over omission.
seedUse: Retain the one painting and completed speech as distinct kinds of insufficiency anxiety.
